text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...We couldn't make a comeback after all, 
could we?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Working systematically toward the goal. 
Yet still falling short—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: There's still a path to victory.
Can we really accept this as "reality"?
Are you sure this is okay as "reality"?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: There's still a path to victory.
Can we really accept this as "reality"?
Are you sure this is okay as "reality"?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...No matter what, you're always looking 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The pain in my clenched fist hurts 
because... I'm frustrated, and I don't 
want to give up...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It might take some time. However—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There must be a path forward that can only 
be found by tasting defeat and struggling 
through it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"A racing career is long... Let us use 
these ups and downs as fuel for growth."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Once again... I look forward to 
working with you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Our growth isn't keeping up with the 
target. ...In that case, we'll just have 
to revise the current plan upward.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Both the training intensity and the 
nutritional content of her meals must be 
reviewed in every aspect.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So that this doesn't become reality. So 
that my feelings become reality.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's difficult... I have to move 
forward!
